body.statement: For constants \(0<c_d\le C_d<\infty\), \(c_d\max\{N^{-1/2},K^{-2}(m\log m)^{-2/d}\}\le R_d(N,K)\le C_d[N^{-1/2}+\min\{r/K^2,K^{-1}m^{-2/d}\}]\). The lower maximum is obtained from two distinct submodels and is not attributed to the printed minimum in Gao--Ge--Qian Proposition 2.
body.justification: The honest sandwich exposes every currently verified polynomial and logarithmic gap instead of promoting the plug-in upper bound to a minimax answer.
body.gap: Manole--Niles-Weed leave logarithmic slack even for the two-margin all-estimator lower bound, while Gao--Ge--Qian do not close the \(d>4\) all-\(K\) frontier.
body.consumer: A solver can see exactly which arm-count and logarithmic factors need a new construction rather than re-proving settled root-\(N\) behavior.
